### 2026-10-07 – I downloaded KiCad, used a template for a Pi HAT and an Esp32 S3 and worked a ton on it and mostly labeled things. I worked a ton on the boot and reset circuits with power buttons and stuff. It was re

**1h**

I downloaded KiCad, used a template for a Pi HAT and an Esp32 S3 and worked a ton on it and mostly labeled things. I worked a ton on the boot and reset circuits with power buttons and stuff. It was really cool. I think I'm doing good and soon enough I will be done, slowly but surely. I also labeled the TX and RX for connecting the ESP32 S3 to the Pi.

**2h**

I basically made the 16 GPIO ports, the 2 servo connectors for my arm, and added a chip for the usb ports. It looks massive but I'm sure I will be done soon. It's completely possible. The wiring took forever though. Writing the name of the labels takes so long! Thank goodness KiCad has a feature where you just have to write the name and it automatically connects it. Routing it will take FOREVER though.

### 2026-10-11 – There was an absolutely absurd amount of errors in the DRC I ran. At first it was 36 because of interference with the Silkscreen but then I tried adjusting locations and eventually adding a big wall o

**3h**

There was an absolutely absurd amount of errors in the DRC I ran. At first it was 36 because of interference with the Silkscreen but then I tried adjusting locations and eventually adding a big wall or blob of GND all over the board in B.Cu and then in F.Cu for 5V and then I did it wrong as I put it in a tiny section of the area that wasn't filled in and I messed it up and there was 79 errors. It was all caused by interference with the mounting holes and the design itself and the wires being too thin and thick and tons of other errors. This was extremely annoying but at least I learned a ton from it. I'm still actively working on the PCB though. It's almost done!!! I just need to check it further and maybe label it a bit more.

**2h**

I found and fixed a ton of warnings in the DRC about the footprints. I had to change pretty much every footprint as I added it wrong and I finally figured it out. Also I had to add some labels on the back too. I am almost done! Just the documentation is left. Also, I modified the tiny servo controller too to have labels. There's a few errors in the ERC but that's because of the pins only connecting to one thing on the stacking header.  It's good now!
